test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question: In March 2020, Prime Minister Narendra Modi handed over his social media account to Indian women achievers to share their achievements. Who among the following was NOT one of them?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vajira Chitrasena.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• In March 2020, Prime Minister Narendra Modi closed all his social media accounts for a day and handed them over to seven female achievers who will share their journeys with everybody.
 
• Seven women are - 
 
 
• Sneha Mohandoss, Malvika Iyer, Arifa Jaan, Kalpana Ramesh, Vijaya Pawar, Kalavati Devi and Veena Devi.
 
 
 
• Extending his greetings to women on International Women's Day (IWD), Prime Minister Modi handed over his social media account to Indian women achievers to share their achievements.​ 
 
• **Hence Vajira Chitrasena is not one of them.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Dr. Vajira Chitrasena**, a veteran Sri Lankan classical dancer, dance choreographer, and teacher, is considered **Sri Lanka’s first prima ballerina.**
 
• Dr. Chitrasena was observed as the epitome of female performance and was mentioned as the **“prima ballerina of Kandyan dance." **
 
• She is the** first Sri Lankan woman to perform the classical Kandyan dance** which was traditionally performed only by men.
 
• She was reported as an honourable recipient of the reputable **Padma Shri award **for her **performance in the arts in January 2020.**
